items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: when you talk to someone like Jay McShann, as I’m sure you’ve done

ctx.x: Yeah. I’m pretty lucky that way.

I know you are. I’m going to come and live in your house. No it’s still this idea that one wants to document. Each time I hear of guy that’s died I think damn, we didn’t get to him. And also I’ve got a very substantial photo archive and I’m kind of always trying to grab the photos, if only to have the chance to copy them. Because otherwise I know they’ll be dished. They’ll be thrown away other than in certain very particular situations. Like Dan Morgenstern was telling us about the Mary Lou Williams Archive which…
talking about things like that, it’s another time and it needs to be sort of documented and preserved.
